timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹436.23 Cr (-11.7% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹128.9 Cr (against a loss of ₹27.36 Cr a year earlier).
VIP Industries released its investor presentation for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.
VIP Industries appointed Ms. Vaishali Shrikant Bhat and Mr. Sanjay Mahesh Rastogi as Independent Directors and noted the resignations of Mr. Tushar Jani and Ms. Payal Kothari.
VIP Industries launched its 'Travel VIP' marketing campaign featuring three new luggage collections starting at ₹6,950.
VIP Industries discontinued sales under the Carlton brand from June 1, 2026, following Supreme Court directions, with no material financial impact.
